{{Quote|The military hires civilians now and again, especially those with appropriate credentials. It just so happens that Squa and I have excellent documentation&mdash;the best that credits can buy&mdash;attesting to our expertise in a number of disciplines. Shipping dispatch and systems controls are among them. With a&hellip; ''patron'' who is attracted to me, I am sure we can get work somewhere in the shipping system.''"<br />"''What if the person in charge of hiring is female? Or some other sex entirely? Like the Triparates of Saloth, out in the Minos Cluster. Ever hear of them?''"<br />"''No, we haven't. And neither has anyone else, because you just invented them.|[[Thula]], [[Kaird]] and [[Squa Tront]]|<ref name="MS:JH">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>}}
'''Saloth''' was a made-up location in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Kaird]] invented that it was home of the [[Triparate]] species.<ref name="MS:JH" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[March]] [[2023]] that Saloth was excluded from [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] because it was an imaginary location.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
